name: cache-meter
description: Prompt-cache hit rate and context fill in one row above the prompt, with a switchable auto-compact threshold and Compact and Clear buttons.

display.title: Display
display.description: gauge shows a five-segment fill level before each percentage; text shows the percentage alone.

details.title: Details
details.description: Show the token counts, such as (100k/1M) in parentheses.
